notes.title: IMPORTANT NOTICE! EVERYONE PLS READ!
notes.content:
- Hey everyone I decided to stay better focused on an ideal game that everyone can enjoy so now with a new goal-oriented mindset, 
I wanna keep my focuses soly on the games that are mostly getting the attention from players that play the game and want the most reliable experience by getting as many frequent updates as promised.

So right now what is gonna happen these games in this list will no longer be listed to buy or possibly not even playable on steam until further notice.
[list]
[*] Matts Project Zombies: Open World
[*] Low Poly Forces
[*] Soundtracks
[*] Soldier Matt Sowards
[/list]

You can still collect this game and or buy a steam key at my Website
https://mattsowards.com as these games will make a return to steam eventually once their more polished.

Why? 
Answer is Simple, I need to stay focused on the community, and what they want and also be able to deliver the best experience possible, and to do that I can only spend my time on so much, so I need your support in testing, leaving honest reviews and streaming or making videos on the game to help bring awareness back to these games.

What about the other games?
So Now your probably wondering why these other games are staying up but not the ones listed above.
Answer is I wanna be able to deliver updates for the games that I see have most interest in, So these games listed here will still stay up, still get updates (far be, at a faster rate now) and right now all work with steam invites, no problems with playing with friends or hosting a match. Give it a try!
- Unlasting Horror
https://store.steampowered.com/app/604230/Unlasting_Horror/?curator_clanid=28129639
- Matts Project Zombies: Endless
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484100/Matts_Project_Zombies_Endless/?curator_clanid=28129639

What About the other games that you have coming soon??
Answer is these games are TO BE ANNOUNCED,
meaning I have a project/early build in mind and already begun work on a a grand scale of a game however, due to technical reasons and Budget. need more time to  fully realize my vision for them, and when I am capable of doing it these will release (most likely after many updates are out and the other two games are fully functional)
- Battle For It All 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/789780/Battle_For_It_All/?curator_clanid=28129639
- Ravesta Racing
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212180/Ravesta_Racing/?curator_clanid=28129639

ps. (Games will not be removed from library just the store page or may not be playable until the game is being developed on again so nothing to fear)

notes.title: Update 1.0 (New Character, Improvements, GORE, & More!!)
notes.content:
Hey everyone this is Developer and Publisher Matt Sowards,
I am back with updates for Matt's Project Zombies Endless this is the first official update I believe for my game and I hope you all enjoy the improvements and fixes and additions added to the game.
Yes this is early access so there may be bugs but if theres anything you find please just report it to me directly or on discord or the forums, I'll fix it no problem.

Changelog:
- Added a female survivor playable character
- Made lighting improvements to all the maps
- Made gameplay improvements to Map 1
- New animations for zombies, attacks, runs, walks, and more.
- New sounds for zombies, attacks, hurt, shot, impacts and more
- New HUD for killing and shooting zombies
- Random Weapon box fixed on Map 1
- Random Weapon Wall Buys added on Map 1
- Improvements made to the games performance
- Music Easter Eggs Collectables added to Map 1 (Star and Rubber Duck)
- Two new songs added to the game.
- Female Jumping sounds added to the female playable character.


Update HOTFIX 
- Fixed some visual glitches
- Fixed some bugs with AI
- Fixed some bugs with settings saving
- Changed logo to new logo on main menu
+ More various fixes.

Update HOTFIX 2 (Added at 6:49 pm Est.)
- Completely overhauled the lighting on Map 1 (Decayed House), new skybox, realistic lighting
- New [BETA] Dynamic Weather System on Map 1 (Decayed House)
+ Many more bug fixes for this update.
